messages:
sam: Heads-up: starting prod deploy v2.11.1 in ~8m. Aim: enable routing/llm-flow-v2 with staged cohorts. Initial cohort: 5% internal only (dev orgs + staging keys) for 15m, then 25% mobile, then 100% after 1h if metrics OK. Pin router model to cantor-1@2026-03-10. Rollback triggers: 5xx >1% sustained 5m, p95 >+40%, or >10% pod restarts in 10m. cc @sre-oncall

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout queued by sam at 1769900000. Plan commands queued:
```
/ff set routing/llm-flow-v2 5% --cohort internal --exclude-region apac
/model pin router cantor-1@2026-03-10
/config set router.max_batch_size=32 --path llm-flow-v2
/monitor enable rollout-telemetry routing/llm-flow-v2
```
I'll post heartbeats every 5m.

taylor: canaries up: canary-1 ok, canary-2 ok, canary-3 OOM once during init: `oom-kill router-worker pid=8421 rss=2.8G`

sre-oncall: Single OOM. Hold at 5% and enable heap profiles on canaries. If restarts continue, do soft-drain.

riley: Exclude apac as planned and reduce canary concurrency to 4.

sam: Applying debug flags and reduced concurrency.

deploy-bot: status @1769900600: routing/llm-flow-v2 at 5% internal. canary-3 restart_count=2. p95 +12% vs baseline, 5xx 0.4%. Heap profiles enabled.

taylor: canary-3 restarted again, now 3 restarts in 12m. Memory growth seen: alloc 1.9G -> 2.7G in 60s. Suspect model memory pattern different.

sre-oncall: Trend looks bad. Recommend soft-drain: remove public cohorts, keep internal for debugging. Collect heap dumps and traces.

sam: Executing soft-drain now:
```
/ff set routing/llm-flow-v2 0% --cohort public
/ff set routing/llm-flow-v2 5% --cohort internal
/incident create "canary memory growth llm-flow-v2" --severity medium
```

deploy-bot: action complete at 1769901200: public cohorts set to 0%. Internal cohort remains 5%. Incident INC-2026-1842 created.

riley: Please gather heap profiles, batch-size histograms, and allocator traces for first 25m. We'll need them for model-team triage.

taylor: uploaded profiles to https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-1842/profiles. Note: OOM sequence and alloc spikes attached.

ops-bot: ops-bot: release notes for v2.11.1 pinned back to draft and public announcement muted. Suggested fallback: try cantor-1 quantized or pin to cantor-0@2026-02-20 if model memory confirmed.

sam: Scheduling 30m triage sync. No further ramp until canaries stable for 60m.
